enchantments.tooltip: Taint of Evil: Good aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.

enchantments.text: A Mysterious Effect - can be any one of these 4 sets:

children.tooltip: Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity. Resistance +3: Passive: +3 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.Fortification +75%: +75% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Strength.Protection +3: Passive: +3 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Constitution. Spell Penetration I: Passive: +1 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
